headline: An AI-made video of a black cat clapping with human hands has turned into a widely copied meme on Instagram and TikTok.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score: harmless internet culture, still spreading, one explainer source.
importance_line: It is a harmless piece of internet culture that shows how one AI-made clip can become a template within weeks, and it affects no decision, with the view count resting on the guide's own word.
summary: The internet-culture site Know Your Meme reports that the "Black Cat Clapping" meme began at the end of September 2026 with an Instagram video by user merkurianin, made or edited with an AI video tool, in which a cat with a human smile and hands stands up and applauds after being fed. The clip passed 2.6 million views within a few weeks and is now used as a green-screen template, including a claymation version from early October.
notes: Read from fulltext. Trend began end of Sep 2026 and is still spreading; editor may treat as an ongoing trend, not stale.
